usage.callShape: GET https://stablefinance.dev/api/financial-metrics/snapshot?ticker=AAPL (x402, no body). GET with query params, NOT POST.
usage.outputShape: body.snapshot — object with ticker, market_cap, enterprise_value, price_to_earnings_ratio, price_to_sales_ratio, gross_margin, operating_margin, net_margin, return_on_equity, debt_to_equity, revenue_growth, earnings_per_share
quirks: Method is GET with query params, NOT POST. The registry surface may label it POST; use GET. Inputs go as URL query params, not a JSON body.
Query params: ticker (US-equity symbol, string minLength1) OR cik (SEC CIK string). additionalProperties is false (only ticker and cik accepted). Provide one (ticker recommended).
Output is nested under body.snapshot (single object of live valuation/margin ratios), not a flat list.
x402 flat $0.02/call (amount 20000 @ 6 decimals). Accepts Base USDC (eip155:8453, payTo 0xBD17480bf6ff056f7b91d9AdC9DfDa001eb7283D), Solana USDC, and Tempo. No API key.

ENVIRONMENT-ONLY: this QA host's OS DNS cannot resolve stablefinance.dev (ENOTFOUND); public DNS resolves it to 216.150.16.193. The qa-pay.mjs dist lacks the dns.lookup patch, so the money-safe pay tool's fetch failed pre-payment (wallet-error, NO money lost). A normal agent on normal DNS is unaffected. NO fresh paid call was executed in this environment; payability + exact schema were confirmed via a direct 402 probe to the known IP (curl --resolve) and the server's x402 bazaar extension.
Same x402 backend (StableFinance / Financial Datasets AI) as /api/earnings and /api/financials which were previously paid+verified.
usage.guide: Call as a GET (not POST) at https://stablefinance.dev/api/financial-metrics/snapshot with a query param ticker (a US-equity symbol like AAPL) — or cik for a SEC CIK. It is an x402 endpoint, flat $0.02/call on Base USDC (also Solana/Tempo), no API key. Read the result from body.snapshot, a single object of live valuation and margin ratios: market_cap, enterprise_value, price_to_earnings_ratio, price_to_sales_ratio, gross_margin, operating_margin, net_margin, return_on_equity, debt_to_equity, revenue_growth, earnings_per_share. Do NOT POST and do NOT send a JSON body.
